blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Asking is a brave act. In trade, we ask questions every day. We ask: How much is the sugar? How much do you want? How many tonnes?

To know the price, you must ask. This is the core of the job. A good trader is not afraid to ask about money. You use "how much" for money and for things you cannot count. You use "how many" for things you can count, like tonnes or containers.

Today we learn five words and questions with how much and how many. When you ask, you learn twice. Asking is trading.

items.q: What does the text say is "the core of the job"?
options: Knowing how to ask about the price
items.why: "To know the price, you must ask. This is the core of the job."

items.q: When do you use "how many"?
items.why: "You use 'how many' for things you can count, like tonnes or containers."

items.q: What does "Asking is trading" suggest?
options: Asking questions is a normal, important part of the work
Only the boss can ask questions
Trading has nothing to do with questions
items.why: Inferência: se perguntar é comerciar, então fazer perguntas é parte central do trabalho.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Questions are part of the job
A good trader asks about money
You should be afraid to ask about the price
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que perguntar é coragem e que o bom trader não tem medo de perguntar.

items.q: "When you ask, you learn twice" suggests that…
options: Only questions about money help you
You must ask the same question two times
Asking gives you more than just the price
items.why: Inferência: perguntar traz a resposta e também conhecimento — você ganha mais do que só o número.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan em uma simulação de ligação com um cliente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, this is a simple call. I am the client, and you are the trader. The client wants a quote. Listen and ask good questions.

Hello, this is the client. I need sugar. How much is the sugar today? Please tell me the price. And how much does the freight cost? Freight is important too.

Good. Now you ask me about quantity. How many tonnes do I need? Yes, ask me that. How many containers are there? These are all easy questions, but they are the heart of the job.

Remember: use "how much" for money and for sugar, because we do not count sugar one by one. Use "how many" for tonnes and for containers, because you can count them.

One more thing, and this is important. A good trader always asks: Can I have a quote? And do not be afraid to say: Can you give a discount? The client will not be angry. Asking is normal, and asking is your job. When you ask, you learn twice. Asking is trading. Okay? Take a breath, smile, and now let us try the call again.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: In the call, who is Ethan playing?
items.why: "I am the client, and you are the trader."

items.q: What does Ethan want the trader to ask about?
options: The price, the freight, and the quantity
items.why: Ele pergunta o preço, o custo do frete e a quantidade (tonnes, containers).

items.q: Why does Ethan say you use "how much" for sugar?
options: Because we do not count sugar one by one
items.why: "use 'how much' for money and for sugar, because we do not count sugar one by one."

items.q: Ethan suggests that asking for a discount is…
items.why: Inferência: "do not be afraid… The client will not be angry. Asking is normal."

items.q: What is Ethan's main goal in this call?
options: To sell sugar to the trader
To teach the trader to ask about price and quantity
items.why: Inferência: é uma simulação de treino — ele guia o trader a fazer as perguntas certas.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "How much is the freight?" We use "how much" to ask about…
options: things we can count one by one
money or things we cannot count
items.why: How much = quanto, para dinheiro ou incontáveis (freight, sugar).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___ tonnes do you need?"
items.why: Tonnes são contáveis, então usamos "how many".

items.q: "The sugar will cost two hundred dollars." Cost means…
items.why: Cost = custar / ter o preço de.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can I have a ___? I want to know the price."
items.why: Quote = cotação: o preço que o cliente pede para saber.

items.q: "Can you give a discount?" A discount is…
items.why: Discount = desconto: um preço mais baixo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em ligações de venda. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you bring down the price?" This asks the seller to…
items.why: Bring down = baixar (o preço).

items.q: "I will send over the quote today." To send over means to…
options: deliver or send something to you
items.why: Send over = enviar / mandar algo para alguém.

items.q: "Let me check on the price and call you back." To check on means to…
items.why: Check on = verificar, se informar sobre algo.

items.q: "The boss must sign off on the discount." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please hold on while I find the number." To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento (no telefone).
